usedFor: Grist holds your product records and Loyverse is the till, so “New Record” can push a variant with “Create Or Update Variant”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in Grist, then “Create Or Update Variant” in Loyverse
bestTemplate.why: A new row in Grist sets up the product variant at the point of sale, with no retyping.

watchOut: “Updated Record” also triggers “Create Or Update Variant”, so an edit in Grist can overwrite that Loyverse variant.
